'''Dave Diehl''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 74 from Warminster, Pa. The slot is listed as Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He ran a website for players in the Philadelphia area.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
Although honored to be a Rebel SM, I do wish there was a Black Squadron program, as Vader is by far the best of the best in the movies.

If ever in the Philadelphia area, look me up if you are interested in getting a game or two in. As long as you don't fear the Dark Side.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
